# Frozen baseline (#3338): packages under mobile/packages that declare a RUNTIME
# Flutter SDK dependency (a `flutter:`/`flutter_web_plugins:` + `sdk: flutter`
# pair in `dependencies:`; `flutter_test` in dev_dependencies is not counted).
# Generated by scripts/check_package_flutter_boundary.sh. The set may only
# SHRINK, except when registering a package that itself ships a native Flutter
# plugin. The missing entry is what makes `depend_on_referenced_packages`
# reject a package:flutter import in that package. Fix an entry by replacing
# the Flutter API with a pure-Dart equivalent, then shrink this baseline.
# Policy and per-package rationale live in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ("Which
# packages may depend on Flutter").
#
# Each reason names the concrete Flutter surface the package uses, so the next
# person can tell a hard dependency from a removal candidate without re-deriving
# it. The three sanctioned groups are: native plugin, presentation layer, and
# consumer of a Flutter-only API with no pure-Dart substitute.
analytics # api: NavigatorObserver + WidgetsBinding (flutter/material)
background_uploader # plugin: ships its own flutter: plugin: block (MethodChannel)
blurhash_service # api: dart:ui (ui.Image, ui.Color) for pixel extraction
caption_generator # plugin: ships its own flutter: plugin: block (MethodChannel)
divine_camera # plugin+ui: own flutter: plugin: block, exports camera widgets
divine_device_attestation # plugin: ships its own iOS flutter: plugin: block (MethodChannel)
divine_quick_actions # plugin: ships its own flutter: plugin: block (MethodChannel)
divine_ui # ui: the design-system package — exports widgets
divine_video_player # plugin+ui: own flutter: plugin: block, exports player widgets
iap_repository # api: defaultTargetPlatform/TargetPlatform (flutter/foundation)
image_metadata_stripper # plugin: ships its own flutter: plugin: block (MethodChannel)
infinite_video_feed # ui: exports the feed widgets
keycast_flutter # plugin: wraps flutter_secure_storage
media_cache # plugin+api: wraps flutter_cache_manager, uses dart:ui + painting
nostr_key_manager # plugin: wraps flutter_secure_storage for signing material
nostr_sdk # api: Android NIP-55 external signer (flutter/services MethodChannel)
permissions_service # plugin: wraps permission_handler + device_info_plus
sound_service # api: kIsWeb (flutter/foundation); wraps just_audio + audio_session
tv_static_effect # ui: exports the static-effect widget
unified_logger # api: kDebugMode/kIsWeb/debugPrint (flutter/foundation)
